There was a Hindu person and a Jewish person talking about the different things they do during religious ceremonies. The Jewish one described a lot of reading from books and gathering as a community, while the Hindu one said that religious ceremonies tend to be organized around some image of a deity that everyone prays to. Who worships idols?
A. The Jewish one
B. The Hindu one
C. Cannot be determined
